manaNeeded: {3}{B}{R}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobold of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Prossh returned to the command zone.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing three Kobold of Kher Keep tokens, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobold of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.
